messages.subject: EFA for panel data
parts:
Hi Phil

Please I have another question about running factor analysis for longitudinal data using MIRT. Is it possible to use one time point( say 2011) to run EFA and two time-points (2012 and 2013) to run CFA. I think about this approach beacause my sapmle size is small so I can't split it to cross-validate the model suggested by EFA and even if I split the data in each time point , the models suggested are not equivalent in the sense that items load differently in factors at each year leading to uncertainty about the best model to submit to confirmatory analysis.

Thanks again for your precious support!!
Makrem.
